statement: For any nonoverlapping placement of the stated expanded covers, the cover intervals at almost every horizontal section are disjoint. The sweep sums each original cover width, and every legal orientation is represented. No two row covers can intersect the same horizontal section because each exceeds half the stock width. Every possible family-count-capped section is exhaustively enumerated. Its exact nonnegative rational weight is at most one. Integration yields the saved lower bound on required vertical span, independent of all translations and family orientations. The convex hull and slabs add space absent from original cog rows. Therefore this certificate can exclude this cover model only; it does not exclude the original 66-part problem, all rigid rows, other covers or any global allocation.
